title: Key to the locked chest
description: The player picks up a key lying on a ledge as a bomb he dropped by the entrance blows open the way down. He carries the key back and down to the locked chest without letting go; as it touches the chest, the chest and the key vanish in two puffs of smoke and the Udjat Eye pops out.
